About this item

  • PROUDLY MADE IN INDIA: The Zulaxy heavy quality Strong nail hook is proudly Made in India. The Zulaxy wall nail hooks has 33% more adhesion, so it is strong and lasts long.
  • STRONG & VERSATILE: Heavy duty hooks can hold up to 10 KG on smooth surface. These adhesive hooks can be used variously: coat hooks, key hooks, bathroom towel hooks.
  • WATERPROOF AND RUSTPROOF: The Zulaxy adhesive hooks are built sturdy enough to hold college student backpacks. The heavy-duty hooks and durable stainless steel construction of non-magnetic metal are corrosion-free, meaning it will last bathroom without rusting.
  • EASY TO USE: Wall hangers easily to clean and paste without surface damage, no need to nail and drill the wall, can be utilized repeatedly after cleaning and dry.
  • USE IT ANYWHERE: Widely used on a variety of surfaces, like Wood, Tile, Ceramic, Metal, Plastic Surface and more, especially great for for bathroom, kitchen, wall decor hooks, shower hooks indoor and outdoor hooks, towel hooks.

    Product Description

    Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks Without Drilling

    Introducing Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks - the superheroes of hanging without drilling! Say goodbye to boring holes in your walls and hello to hassle-free hanging.

    Previous page

    1. Wipe and clean the surface before installtion

    2. Peel the plastic covering beside the adhesive hook

    3. Stick the hook pressing all around

    4. Use hook after leaving it 24 hours to dry & settle

    Next page

    Unlock Maximum Adhesion: Wait 2 Days for Peak Performance!

    For optimal adhesion and durability, allow a mere 48 hours for the hooks to bond securely to your chosen surface. This brief waiting period ensures maximum performance, providing you with a reliable solution for organizing your space without the need for drilling.

    Experience Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks!

    The video showcases the product in use.The video guides you through product setup.The video compares multiple products.The video shows the product being unpacked.

    aplus content video

    Discover the magic of Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks! Our video showcases the simplicity and convenience of hanging photo frames without drilling. With strong adhesive backing and hassle-free installation, you can transform your space in seconds.

    No Mess, No Stress, Just Drill-Free Delight!

    Less mess, more looks!

    Elevate your décor with precision and ease. Say goodbye to mess and hello to pristine walls – no drill required!

    Use it anywhere, multipurpose!

    Beyond frames, they excel! Perfect for hanging keys, decorations, and more. Versatile, strong, and drill-free

    • How do I install the adhesive photo frame hooks?

      Simply peel off the protective backing and stick them onto a clean, dry surface.

    • Can I remove the hooks without damaging the walls?

      Yes, they can be easily removed by gently peeling them off, leaving no residue or damage behind.

    • What materials can these hooks adhere to?

      They work well on various surfaces including painted walls, tiles, glass, wood, and metal.

    • How much weight can these hooks support?

      Each hook can typically support several KGs, depending on the surface and conditions of use. It's recommended to paste on a smooth surface for longevity.

    • Will these hooks survive my toddler's "artistic" experiments?

      Absolutely! These hooks are toddler-tested and tantrum-approved for hanging everything from masterpieces to macaroni necklaces.

    Technical specifications

    Dimensions Each hook measures 6*6 CM, offering ample space for various items.
    Versatile Use Perfect for hanging frames, keys, hats, and more, making it an ideal solution for organizing any space.
    Enhanced Strength With 33% higher strength than competitors, these hooks provide reliable support for heavier items.
    Damage-Free Installation Adhesive backing ensures easy and mess-free application, leaving walls intact upon removal.
    Long-lasting Adhesion Resistant to moisture and temperature changes, ensuring a secure hold over time.

      Good for light items, but fails with larger photo frames
      Reviewed in India on 13 August 2026
      Size: 10 PACKColour: Photo Frame Hook
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      I bought these to hang some pictures, but the adhesive just isn't strong enough for the job.

      Pros:

      >> Lightweight Use: They actually work well for very small, light items like kitchen utensils and tiny knick-knacks.

      Cons:

      >> False Advertising: They can't handle photo frames slightly larger than A4.

      >> Weak Adhesive: After about a month of use, the glue completely came off the wall. My frame fell down with the hook still attached to it.

      Overall, I would not recommend this product if you are planning to hang slightly heavy objects. Stick to extremely light items if you buy these.

    About this Item

    • PROUDLY MADE IN INDIA: The Zulaxy heavy quality Strong nail hook is proudly Made in India. The Zulaxy wall nail hooks has 33% more adhesion, so it is strong and lasts long.
    • STRONG & VERSATILE: Heavy duty hooks can hold up to 10 KG on smooth surface. These adhesive hooks can be used variously: coat hooks, key hooks, bathroom towel hooks.
    • WATERPROOF AND RUSTPROOF: The Zulaxy adhesive hooks are built sturdy enough to hold college student backpacks. The heavy-duty hooks and durable stainless steel construction of non-magnetic metal are corrosion-free, meaning it will last bathroom without rusting.
    • EASY TO USE: Wall hangers easily to clean and paste without surface damage, no need to nail and drill the wall, can be utilized repeatedly after cleaning and dry.
    • USE IT ANYWHERE: Widely used on a variety of surfaces, like Wood, Tile, Ceramic, Metal, Plastic Surface and more, especially great for for bathroom, kitchen, wall decor hooks, shower hooks indoor and outdoor hooks, towel hooks.

    Product description

    Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks - the superheroes of hanging without drilling! Say goodbye to boring holes in your walls and hello to hassle-free hanging. Discover the magic of Zulaxy Adhesive Photo Frame Hooks! Our video showcases the simplicity and convenience of hanging photo frames without drilling. With strong adhesive backing and hassle-free installation, you can transform your space in seconds.
